items.title: Adding a camera says what went wrong
items.text: On the camera page, a wrong or empty address now tells you so, and if the app does not answer the page says that. The card in the app no longer waits forever: after a minute and a half with no camera it says so, and it still finishes if the camera arrives late.

items.title: Updates ask once, and say why if they fail
items.text: The in-app update now always shows the system's confirm screen, and if Android refuses it the message says why, including when the new build is signed with a different key.
